description: Two clippers on one panel, each holding a signal to a threshold and then applying a gain

params.text: Sets the voltage that half clips to, 0V at fully counter-clockwise to 6V fully clockwise
Sets the gain applied after clipping, silent at fully counter-clockwise and five times fully clockwise

inputs.text: Adds to that half's clipping threshold, half a volt per volt
Adds to that half's gain, half a unit per volt

outputs.text: The clipped signal at the gain set for that half

notes: with the threshold knob fully counter-clockwise and nothing patched to its threshold input the threshold is 0V, and the output is silent whatever is patched in
